items.text: Add the date 2026-11-04: “Green Claims commission confirms withdrawal of the proposal”
items.reason: On 4 November 2026, the European Commission officially confirmed its decision to withdraw and scrap the Green Claims Directive proposal.

items.text: New status text: “Withdrawn. The European Commission officially confirmed in November 2026 that it is scrapping the proposed directive.”
items.reason: The status needed updating to reflect that the Commission officially confirmed the withdrawal of the proposal in November 2026.
